insert into CHB_SYS_ROLE_HIS(ROLE_ID, STATUS, HIS_NO, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_POS, BUSI_TYPE, DATA_AUTHORITY_SELF_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_DEPT_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, TRADE_DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_CODE ) select ROLE_ID, STATUS, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_ROLE_HIS where STATUS IN('E','D') and ROLE_ID = #{roleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) + 1 as HIS_NO, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_POS, BUSI_TYPE, DATA_AUTHORITY_SELF_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_DEPT_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, TRADE_DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME, ORG_CODE
from CHB_SYS_ROLE where STATUS IN('E','D') and ROLE_ID = #{roleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

insert into CHB_SYS_ROLE_HIS(ROLE_ID, STATUS, HIS_NO, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_POS, BUSI_TYPE, DATA_AUTHORITY_SELF_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_DEPT_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, TRADE_DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_CODE ) select ROLE_ID, STATUS, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_ROLE_HIS where STATUS = 'E' and ROLE_ID = CHB_SYS_ROLE.ROLE_ID) + 1 as HIS_NO, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_POS, BUSI_TYPE, DATA_AUTHORITY_SELF_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_DEPT_FLG, DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, TRADE_DATA_AUTHORITY_ALL_FLG, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME, ORG_CODE
from CHB_SYS_ROLE where STATUS = 'E' and WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
